items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: And Clyde Kersenior was one of my teachers. And after about six months, he thought I was good enough to, to be in his band.

ctx.x: and you, you didn't know a note of music? You hadn't? No idea. And you really didn't even really know if you really, if you really had the aptitude. Right. To really do it. Right. So,

I'm 21. Yeah. And I'm going to music school. But I was very fortunate. I was surrounded by professional musicians who wanted to go to music school and get that money. All these, all these guys, a lot of these guys were working around in, in, in the bands that I used to go listen to. Mm-hmm. Some of them were teachers. Clyde Kersenior was a teacher. Willie Humphrey was a teacher. Uh, different people like that. They, and the way Grunewald School of Music worked is that you had classes, but you also had what they…
and I started. You started playing with Clyde Kersenior? Yeah. That's pretty, that's pretty amazing.
